feeds.title: O-Trail Rail Fans
feeds.description: Rail Fans Canada is a railfan operated enthusiast website, with the aim of showcasing the O-Train, Metro, SkyTrain, and Subway rail transit networks operated in Canada. These transit systems represent significant milestones in a city's history and recognizing this fact we felt it was important to showcase these transit systems so that other interested people can learn more about what makes them special and unique.
